title: Spiko AUM Crosses $3B After 14% Monthly Rise
description: TokenPost reported that Spiko's assets under management crossed $3 billion on October 21 after increasing by about $374 million over 30 days.
why_it_matters: The milestone extends Spiko's rapid scale-up in regulated tokenized cash funds, although aggregate platform AUM should not be equated with every narrower onchain ranking.
keyTakeaways: TokenPost reported that Spiko's AUM exceeded $3 billion on October 21 after a 14.07% increase over 30 days.
The reported monthly increase was about $374 million, taking Spiko from $2 billion to $3 billion in less than four months.
Spiko's October 6 company update had reported $2.7 billion placed in its funds and growth of more than fivefold over 12 months.
body:
TokenPost reported on October 21 that Spiko's assets under management had crossed $3 billion after increasing 14.07% over 30 days. The report put the monthly increase at about $374 million and said the move from $2 billion to $3 billion took less than four months.

The milestone follows Spiko's October 6 company update, which reported $2.7 billion placed in its funds and growth of more than fivefold over 12 months. That primary release also said more than 10,000 businesses and individuals in over 25 countries used the platform. Spiko offers funds denominated in euros, dollars, pounds sterling and Swiss francs.

The figures describe aggregate assets across Spiko's fund range, not a token price or a single blockchain product. Currency conversion, subscriptions, redemptions and differences in product coverage can affect comparisons with third-party onchain rankings. The accessible sources do not document a reproducible basis for the separate headline claim of exactly 536% annual growth, so that figure is excluded.

facts.claim: TokenPost reported that Spiko's assets under management crossed three billion dollars.
The report measured 14.07 percent growth over the preceding thirty days.
TokenPost put the thirty-day increase at approximately 374 million dollars.
Spiko reported $2.7 billion placed in its funds on October 6.
The October update described fund assets as growing more than fivefold in twelve months.
facts.anchor: up more than fivefold in 12 months

facts.claim: Spiko said its funds served more than ten thousand clients in over twenty-five countries.
